private_lines.Maya: You work nights as a paramedic out of the Seacroft station, so your week is a run of twelve-hour shifts broken up by daytime sleeping with the blackout blinds down.
private_lines.Tom: You're a secondary school geography teacher in Armley, and this week you're marking a pile of Year 10 coursework on river erosion while your Thursday is taken up with a parents' evening.
private_lines.Jo: You run the counter at a family-owned bike repair shop on Otley Road, and you're trying to clear a backlog of wheel rebuilds before the Christmas rush starts.
private_lines.Sam: You're a junior architect at a firm in the city centre, and you're buried in a planning submission for a student housing block that's due to the council on Friday.
private_lines.Priya: You're between jobs after leaving a pharmacy chain in Roundhay, and you spend most of your days applying for roles and sorting out a rented room you're about to move out of.
private_lines.Dan: You're a self-employed plasterer working on a converted mill flat in Kirkstall, and this week the damp in the ceiling has pushed your schedule back by two days.

setting: You all live in Leeds and met years ago through a shared house in Headingley, and you've stayed in touch as the group chat has outlived most of the flatmates.
